events.location: Aspire Tutorials, #46, 4th Main “A” Cross, behind R.T. Nagar Old Police Station, Kousar Nagar, Bangalore – 560032
events.description: A space to pause, reflect, and explore what the Quran has to say about finding direction when life feels uncertain.

events.speaker: Mariyam Qurayshi
events.description: An honest first gathering on direction, return, and hope.
events.recap:
The Qur’an came to guide humanity and transform the world.
Ibn Masʿūd’s journey shows that anyone can achieve greatness through faith and learning.
A sincere, teachable heart is the first step toward transformation.
Act on guidance immediately instead of postponing change.
Learning and teaching the Qur’an are among the greatest pursuits.
The Qur’an should transform your character, not just your knowledge.
Faith gives courage to stand for the truth.
Recitation should be accompanied by understanding and reflection.
Build a personal connection with the Qur’an and find your “garden” within it.
Approach the Qur’an with a willingness to change your heart and actions.

events.speaker: Mariyam Qurayshi
events.description: A conversation about belonging, identity, and the Quranic lens.
events.recap:
Stay close to Allah: Remember Him regularly to find peace and strengthen your faith.
Stand firm in faith: The People of the Cave remained believers despite societal pressure.
Resist peer pressure: Don’t compromise your values just to fit in with others.
Find your cave: Build a safe environment through your masjid, home, Islamic community, and righteous friends.
Choose friends wisely: Surround yourself with people who encourage you to grow closer to Allah.
Avoid harmful company: Friendships that pull you away from Allah may lead to regret.
Combine effort with trust: Plan carefully, take action, make duʿā’, and trust Allah.
Trust Allah as Al-Wali: Allah is the Protective Guardian, working in ways we may not see.
Be patient with Allah’s plan: His promises are true, even when the outcome takes time.
Make the right choices now: Build your community, hold onto your values, and keep Allah at the centre of your life.
